page: Basic Auth Middleware for HTTP Basic Authentication. Simplifies Basic auth implementation on Cloudflare Workers and other platforms. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {basicAuth} from 'hono/basic-auth'. Options: username (required, string), password (required, string), realm (optional, string, default 'Secure Area'), hashFunction (optional, Function), verifyUser (optional, (username, password, c) => boolean | Promise<boolean>), invalidUserMessage (optional, string | object | MessageFunction), onAuthSuccess (optional, (c, Context, username: string) => void | Promise<void>), ...users (optional, {username, password}[] array). HTTP header: WWW-Authenticate returned on auth failure. Use cases: path-based auth, route-specific auth, custom verification function, multiple users, post-auth callbacks. MessageFunction signature: (c: Context) => string | object | Promise<string | object>. Context methods: c.set(), c.get(). MDN Basic auth scheme reference. Questions: How to add basic auth to routes? Can I verify credentials manually? How to define multiple users? What happens on auth failure? Can I set context after auth? How to customize error messages?

sections.manifest: Import statements for Basic Auth middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for the main framework class. import {basicAuth} from 'hono/basic-auth' for the middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is basicAuth located?

Basic Auth usage patterns. Pattern 1: Apply to path prefix with app.use('/auth/*', basicAuth({username, password})). Example: username 'hono', password 'acoolproject'. Routes under /auth/* require auth. Pattern 2: Apply to specific route with HTTP method. Example: app.delete('/auth/page', basicAuth({username, password}), handler). Pattern 3: Custom verification with verifyUser option. verifyUser returns true for success, can check any credentials. Responds with c.text() on success. Questions: How to restrict specific paths? How to protect individual routes? How to verify custom credentials? What response is sent after auth?

Basic Auth options specification. Required: username (string), password (string). Optional: realm (string, default 'Secure Area', used in WWW-Authenticate header per MDN directives), hashFunction (Function for password hashing), verifyUser ((username, password, c: Context) => boolean | Promise<boolean> for custom verification), invalidUserMessage (string | object | MessageFunction for error response, MessageFunction is (c: Context) => string | object | Promise<string | object>), onAuthSuccess ((c: Context, username: string) => void | Promise<void> callback after successful auth to set context variables or side effects). Questions: Which options are required? What's the default realm? How to customize verification? How to customize error messages? What can onAuthSuccess do?

Additional options for multiple users. ...users parameter as {username: string, password: string}[] array. Allows passing multiple user credential objects. Can define additional params in first object only. Subsequent objects only contain username and password pairs. Questions: How to define multiple users? Can I pass user arrays? What can go in each user object?

Multiple users recipes and patterns. Hardcoded users example: multiple basicAuth() arguments with username/password in each, other params like realm only in first object. Config-based pattern: import users array from external config file, pass first user with realm spread as first arg and remaining users spread as additional args using spread operator (...users.slice(1)). Allows dynamic user management from config. Questions: How to add multiple hardcoded users? How to load users from config? Can I combine config and options? Does order matter?
